thread:
alex.garcia: Hey team — planning my parental leave for June/July and thinking about a phased return (3 days onsite, 2 remote) plus staying on a light on-call rotation for a couple weeks. Quick Qs: 1) What paperwork do I need to file for CA SDI + Redwood top-up? 2) How do I preserve PTO vs use it during the leave? 3) Any suggestions for handing off on-call so coverage is solid?
people-ops: Congrats, Alex! :tada: High-level: you’ll need to submit the state disability/family leave form (SDI) and our internal parental leave request form. We top up state benefits for eligible folks — People Ops handles the top-up once we have the SDI determination letter and the signed company leave form. I can DM you the checklist.
marc-engr: For on-call, happy to run a two-week staggered handoff. Can you make a quick runbook of urgent steps and escalation contacts? If you’re still reachable for PagerDuty escalations, we can set an auto-escalate rule so someone else gets the first page.
alex.garcia: Thanks — I can do a runbook. For paperwork, where do I upload the SDI docs? Payroll site?
people-ops: Upload to the benefits portal: https://benefits.redwood.com/leave-forms (select "Parental Leave / SDI") and cc benefits@redwood.com. Steps: 1) Fill our internal leave request form (link is on the portal), 2) submit SDI claim with CA EDD, 3) when you get the EDD determination PDF, upload it and mark it as "EDD determination" on the portal.
payroll-bot: Reminder: to ensure top-up on the next paycheck, benefits docs must be in the portal by the last day of the pay period covering your first leave week. Missing docs delay top-up by one pay cycle.
people-ops: PTO: You can elect to use accrued PTO to fill gaps or save PTO to stack after leave. If you use PTO concurrently with SDI, payroll will combine it with state pay up to your normal salary. If you want to reserve PTO, just note that on the internal form and we’ll set payroll accordingly.
benjamin.h: Quick operational note — for code ownership I can pick up your daily deploy checklist and the DB migration slot while you’re out. Alex, can you tag the repos and add a short PR checklist?
alex.garcia: Will do. How about FMLA paperwork — do I need it too?
people-ops: If you’re eligible (12 months tenure + hours), we’ll initiate FMLA paperwork for job protection. That’s separate from SDI/payroll; we’ll send you the FMLA packet and you sign/return. For CA, CFRA/FMLA runs concurrently in most cases.
marc-engr: One more thought — let’s set up a calendar block for the first week back: shadowing + handover sync. Also recommend an async FAQ doc so the team can triage without paging you.
alex.garcia: Awesome. Can you confirm deadline for submitting the internal form?
people-ops: Prefer 30 days before leave start, but we can accept later with a note. For payroll/top-up: portal docs must be uploaded before the end of the last pay period that includes the first leave day to guarantee top-up on the immediate payroll. If you need help, book a 15-min with me: https://calendly.com/people-ops/leave-help.
alex.garcia: Thanks everyone — will upload SDI claim this week and send the runbook. Appreciate the help :heart:
people-ops: Happy to help, Alex. We’ll follow up once we have the EDD PDF. Ping if anything changes.
